args.query: apache felix osgi framework dependency version

questions.why: Second value anchor on a different build.gradle (sensorhub-core-osgi): felix is the corpus's only `implementation`-configuration dep, version 7.0.3 unique at the pin. expect_all pairs name+version so a stray '7.0.3' elsewhere cannot pass it alone. The configuration VALUE is deliberately not asserted: 'implementation' is a substring of 'testImplementation' (authoring rule: no substring-colliding literals).

config_band: added in v2 (new comparability domain — v2 scores NEVER compare with v1): #157 gave gradle/pom entities dc.terms.title (name-level facts reachable via graph_search labels), and graph-search-match-properties renders allowlisted VALUE properties on matches (version/kind/scope/configuration) when the substrate response carries entity triples. G01 isolates name-level (passes on #157 alone); G02/G03 are the value gate — they FAIL before the properties change and PASS after. Only configurations the regex parser ingests (implementation|testImplementation|api|compileOnly|runtimeOnly) exist in the graph.
